correctness.rationale: Smooth quartic in characteristic 3, genus three. Direct exhaustive F9/F81/F729 projective point counts independently checked by two arithmetic enumeration methods give 1,109,892. Newton identities and the genus-three Weil functional equation uniquely yield (1-3T+9T^2)^3. Elliptic E(F3) has seven points, hence trace -3; trace after base change to F9 is 3. Equality of Weil polynomials implies F9-isogeny by Tate. The code is actual embedded verifier, not an infinite numerical extrapolation.
